purpose.zh: 拉伸大腿内侧，让髋更灵活
purpose.en: Stretch your inner thigh for more mobile hips.

text.zh: 背保持平直，臀部往后坐向脚跟
text.en: Keep your back flat and sit your hips back toward your heel

text.zh: 一条腿往侧面伸直，整只脚踩地，脚尖朝前。
text.en: Reach one leg straight out to the side, foot flat and toes forward.

text.zh: 大腿内侧有拉伸感时停一下，再往前回。
text.en: Pause when you feel the inner thigh stretch, then rock forward.

commonErrors.en: Rounding the back as you sit back.

commonErrors.zh: 伸直那条腿的脚离地或膝盖弯了
commonErrors.en: Lifting the straight-leg foot or bending that knee.

cautions.zh: 大腿根内侧刺痛时停下
cautions.en: Stop if you feel sharp pain in your inner groin.

changes: 文案与动画一致，只改口语（背部保持平直→背保持平直等）、caution 短句
